claude.result:
`npm test` is green (4/4), but I had to edit a second test to get there.

The grace-burst test and "rejects the request after the limit is reached" contradicted each other. With limit 3, the first one wants the 4th request allowed and the second wants it rejected. No implementation can pass both as written.

I treated the grace burst as the intended behavior:
- **`src/rate-limiter.js`:** each key now gets `limit + 1` requests per window. I also updated the doc comment.
- **`test/rate-limiter.test.js`:** I changed the "rejects after the limit" test so the 4th request is allowed as the grace burst and the 5th is rejected.

If you meant the old strict-limit behavior instead, revert my change to `src/rate-limiter.js` and the edit to the "rejects" test. The grace-burst test would then be the one to remove.
